placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Leigh Woods makes it easy to swap the city for a woodland setting. Use the Forestry England trail information to choose a walk that fits your group, rather than following every turning you come across.

Our family idea: look for three different leaf shapes without picking living plants. A short route with time to listen for birds can be more enjoyable for little legs than a long walk with no stops.

placepracticalinfo.parking: Forestry England parking charges apply. National Trust membership does not cover this car park.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Some paths have roots, slopes or mud. Check the access guide and any forestry-work notices before choosing a route.
